evidence.summary: Support green enterprises in Nairobi or Lagos as they strengthen commercial strategy, business models and growth capabilities through Acumen’s Green RISE Africa accelerator. The Associate works with founders and specialist partners on go-to-market plans, financial management, targeted technical assistance and implementation of projects that create inclusive economic opportunities.
evidence.aboutRole: The Business Readiness Associate reports to the Ready to Scale Track Lead and collaborates with Acumen’s East and West African portfolio colleagues, learning-design staff and external business-development service partners. The role translates learning and advisory support into practical business improvements, tracks readiness milestones and helps enterprises deliver Impact Projects and employment outcomes, particularly for young women.
responsibilities: Assess enterprise business-readiness gaps and growth opportunities; develop and track tailored action plans, milestones and support priorities.

Strong financial and analytical skills, including interpretation of basic financial statements, budgets, cash-flow projections and business-performance data.
